Orton's Apartment.description: A modest one-bedroom apartment on the third floor. Moving boxes are scattered around, some still unopened. Sunlight streams through clean windows, and the air smells like fresh paint and cardboard.

Apartment Hallway.description: A well-maintained hallway with beige carpet and fluorescent lighting. Several apartment doors line both sides, and you can hear the muffled sounds of neighbors going about their daily routines.

Stairwell.description: A clean concrete stairwell with metal railings. Emergency lighting fixtures are mounted on the walls, and the stairs echo slightly with footsteps.

Elevator.description: A small but functional elevator with mirrored walls and a digital floor display. Soft muzak plays from hidden speakers.

Ground Floor Lobby.description: A modest apartment building lobby with a mailbox wall, a bulletin board, and a glass entrance door leading to the street. Potted plants sit near the windows.

Outside Building.description: The sidewalk in front of your apartment building. Portland's overcast sky looms above, and you can see other residential buildings, parked cars, and people walking by going about their normal lives.

Neighborhood Street.description: A typical Portland residential street lined with trees and modest apartment buildings. Cars are parked along the curb, and you can see a few local shops and a coffee place down the block.

Coffee Shop.description: A cozy neighborhood coffee shop with local art on the walls and the aroma of freshly brewed coffee. A few regulars sit at small tables with laptops.

Corner Store.description: A small convenience store with basic groceries, snacks, and everyday items. The owner greets customers warmly from behind the counter.
